name: SIMCO Global Technology & Systems Ltd.
india_angle: SIMCO Global is a key distributor and service provider for semiconductor equipment in India, representing several international brands.
summary: SIMCO Global Technology & Systems Ltd. is a prominent distributor and service provider in the semiconductor industry, focusing on the Indian market. They offer a range of deposition systems and other semiconductor equipment through exclusive partnerships with leading global manufacturers.
